snippet.title: Heir of the Dog - Official trailer (English)
snippet.description:
Website: https://heirofthedog.co.uk
Steam: https://heirofthedog.co.uk/steam

Heir of the Dog is a pixel art comedy point-and-click adventure game inspired by Jekyll & Hyde. When visiting his uncle's laboratory, upper class twit Cummerbund Bandersnatch discovers an experimental new formula guaranteeing a ‘good time’ for whoever drinks it. Seduced by promises in his uncle's journal, he drinks the strange elixir and undergoes a monstrous transformation. Life will never be the same again.
